item.title: M.S. Robotics
item.description:
• Concentration in Electrical Engineering
  • Relevant coursework: Robot Mechanics and Control, Mobile Robotics

item.title: Electrical Engineer Intern
item.description:
• Drafted power, lighting, and fire alarm system layouts and power service diagrams for 20+ commercial buildings in AutoCAD and Revit
  • Verified designs for National Electrical Code compliance and coordinated with mechanical and plumbing teams to resolve cross-discipline conflicts

item.title: B.S. Electrical Engineering
item.description:
• Certificate in Autonomy and Robotics
  • GPA: 3.97 · Summa Cum Laude
  • Member of Tau Beta Pi, the Engineering Honor Society
  • Relevant coursework: Autonomy I & II, Microcontroller Systems, Electronics I, Machine Learning for Engineers, Signals & Systems, Senior Experience in Engineering Design

item.title: Teaching Assistant, Microcontroller Systems
item.description:
• Debugged students’ embedded C++ code and troubleshot circuits using Arduino UNO during three weekly lab sessions for 50+ students
  • Helped teach and develop lab materials covering analog and digital inputs and outputs, segment displays, LCDs, stepper and DC motors, encoders, sensors, and core circuit design principles

item.title: Semester Abroad
item.description:
• Semester study abroad in the Bachelor of Electrical and Electronics Engineering program
  • Relevant coursework: Controls Engineering, Power Electronics, Electronics Project

item.title: Resident Advisor
item.description:
• Worked in the dorms as an intermediary between university administration and on-campus students
  • Excelled in training for conflict resolution, leadership, interpersonal and cultural awareness, and management
  • Organized social events for students to engage with the community and each other, and fostered a caring environment where students felt involved and open to share their thoughts

item.title: Undergraduate Researcher
item.description:
• Optimized the dispatching of renewable energy resources for large-scale power grids and conducted rigorous performance benchmarking using Julia’s BenchmarkTools library
  • Utilized the Gurobi numerical solver with CUDA for multi-threading and GPU parallel processing
  • Decreased processing times by up to 40% and total memory allocation by up to 99%

item.title: Engineering Design Camp Counselor
item.description:
• Led and mentored groups of 20+ children through various hands-on engineering projects, fostering creativity and technical skills
  • Taught proficiency in 3D modeling and printing, laser cutting, vinyl cutting, physical assembly, and Adobe Suite
  • Created hand-made ukuleles for each of the students through iterative design, allowing the students to create their own designs

item.title: NURobotics Marine Team
item.description:
• Developing the code base for the MATE Robotics ROV Competition using ROS 2 and Python, including thruster controllers, camera integration, end effector controller, and input and sensor reading
  • Improving code base testability, utilizing pytest to verify the integrity of ROS node functions
  • Standardizing code base organization and documentation across ROS nodes, using Git for version control and collaboration
